title: Derived unit and Leray identity
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\mathcal A_X$ be its category of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $K\in D(\mathcal A_X)$. Write $U=D((\mathrm{id}_X)^{-1})$ for the exact inverse image induced on the derived category [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], $\eta$ for the unit of $U\dashv R(\mathrm{id}_X)_*$, and $\lambda:R\Gamma_X\circ R(\mathrm{id}_X)_*\simeq R\Gamma_X$ for the Leray comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Write $E:U\simeq\mathrm{id}$ for the localization of the inverse-image identity isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], followed by the localization identity comparison. In functional order, $R\Gamma_X(E_K)\circ\lambda_{U(K)}\circ R\Gamma_X(\eta_K)=\mathrm{id}_{R\Gamma_X(K)}$. This is an equality of morphisms of derived abelian groups, before applying homology, with no boundedness restriction on $K$.

proof.text: Let E be mapDerivedCategoryNatIso(upperStarId) followed by mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. Define I:R(id_X)_*≅id by the exact-functor comparison rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso(lowerStarId), and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. The factorization laws identify E and I on Qh objects with their underived identity maps. Lift upperStarId_hom_app_unit_app termwise to complexes and then to the homotopy category. Use derivedη_fac_app and naturality of rightDerivedFunctorUnit to show eta followed by R(E) equals I.inv. Cancel I.hom and use rightDerived_ext to check this equality after the right-derived unit; the underived unit equation cancels the identity comparisons.

proof.text: First prove that lowerStarId.inv followed by lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso is the identity after applying global sections: conjugate by ΓNatIsoSheafSections and evaluate at the terminal object. The two maps of terminal objects compose to the identity by terminal uniqueness. Derive this cancellation using rightDerived_ext for Γ. The factorization law for rightDerivedFunctorCompIso and rightDerivedNatTrans_fac gives the Leray comparison law after the composite derived unit. Expand that unit, use naturality of the Γ derived unit, and lift the underived cancellation termwise to the homotopy category. This proves RΓ(I.inv) followed by the Leray comparison is the identity.

proof.text: Evaluate the two preceding natural-transformation identities at K. Naturality of the Leray comparison at E_K moves RΓ(E_K) to RΓ(R(E_K)) before Leray. Functoriality combines this with RΓ(eta_K). Substitute eta_K followed by R(E_K)=I.inv_K, and then the cancellation RΓ(I.inv_K) followed by Leray_K=id. All constructions and factorization laws are on the unbounded derived category; no boundedness assumption is used.

theorem derivedUnitLeray_id (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X)).unit.app K) ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X)).hom.app
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso
          (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).hom.app K) = 𝟙 _
